name: Planar Water Reflection and Refraction
definition: A water rendering technique that renders the scene twice into separate Framebuffer Objects (FBOs) to generate reflection and refraction textures, which are then blended on a water surface shader. It handles both planar ocean water and placed water blocks.
summary: Planar Water Reflection and Refraction renders voxel water by generating separate reflection and refraction textures via Framebuffer Objects, optimized for axis-aligned surfaces using fixed horizontal clip planes.
